title: Machine learning prediction of long-term postoperative pneumonia risk: a retrospective cohort study.
summary: A retrospective 365-day postoperative-pneumonia risk model was tested on a separate internal set; the low 7.4% PPV narrows its potential to screening/rule-out use.
ai_technology: 11,655 surgical encounters, 238 365-day pneumonia events; RF with oversampling AUC .886, sensitivity 85.4%, specificity 77.4%, PPV 7.4%, NPV 99.6%; internal separate test and 5-fold CV.
